title: Display Dunning Run Exceptions
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM

In addition to interest, you can also levy various charges on your business partner. If you set the indicator Interest before Charges ,
you can define whether the interest is to be calculated before the charges in the dunning activity run. This is necessary, for
example, if the amount of the charges is to be dependent on the interest calculated. To create this dependence, define a function

module for event 0360 in the Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under Program
Enhancements — Define Customer-Specific Function Modules . SAP delivers function module FKK_SPECIALCHARGE_0360 as an
example implementation for such a calculation. This enables you to restrict the amount of the dunning charges if you levy dunning
interest as well as dunning charges.

Define the minimum interest amount that can be posted for a dunning notice.

For detailed information, see the documentation for the corresponding fields.

Display Dunning Run Exceptions

The Display Dunning Run Exceptions ( F7575) app provides a detailed view of the exceptions that occurred for business partners
in a dunning run.

Key Features

You select the required exceptions by using the available filters, such as Dunning Run Date, Dunning Run ID, and Business
Partner.

In the overview, you can jump to the detail view of the selected exceptions to track the errors that led to the exception.

Integration

In the Analyze Dunning Run Exceptions app, if you select a business partner for whom dunning exceptions exist in the overview
and then choose Display Dunning Exceptions, you branch to the Display Dunning Run Exceptions app.

SAP Fiori Implementation Information

For information about implementation of the Display Dunning Run Exceptions app, see SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library.
